boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission or no-purchase activities at UNT and nearby Denton sites, with access details checked on August 13, 2026.

cards.title: Browse UNT Art Mart
cards.subtitle: University Union · UNT campus
cards.notes: Walk the student-vendor festival with friends and enjoy the free-attendance activities; purchases from vendors are optional.
cards.short_summary: A free-entry campus art market with optional shopping.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT states that Art Mart is free for everyone to attend and includes free activities for UNT students.
cards.access_notes: Check the Art Mart page for the next event date; vendor items may be purchased but are not required.

cards.entity_name: Guest Artist Recital: Richard Novak, Stations of Mychal
cards.title: Hear a guest-artist recital
cards.subtitle: Paul Voertman Concert Hall · Music Building
cards.notes: Gather for the September 3 recital and take a general-seating seat; arrive early enough to settle in before the program.
cards.short_summary: A free public College of Music performance.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT lists this September 3, 2026 guest-artist recital as free and open to the public with general seating.
cards.source_title: Guest Artist Recital: Richard Novak, Stations of Mychal
cards.access_notes: September 3, 2026, 6:30 p.m.; general seating. Confirm the program before leaving.

cards.title: Explore the courthouse museum
cards.subtitle: 110 W Hickory Street · Downtown Denton
cards.notes: See the restored 1896 courthouse and its history exhibits, then ask staff about a guided tour if your group wants context.
cards.short_summary: A downtown history museum in Denton's former courthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Denton County says admission to the Courthouse-on-the-Square Museum is free and guided tours are available on request.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed Sundays and most major holiday weekends.

cards.title: Walk Denton County Historical Park
cards.subtitle: 317 W Mulberry Street · South of the Square
cards.notes: Stroll the open grounds and historic buildings with friends, then check the county calendar for a compatible community program.
cards.short_summary: A county history park with historic structures and open space.
cards.evidence_claim: Denton County states that admission to Denton County Historical Park is free.
cards.access_notes: Wednesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; the park is closed Sunday and most major holiday weekends.

cards.title: Step through Bayless-Selby House
cards.subtitle: Denton County Historical Park · 317 W Mulberry Street
cards.notes: Visit the Victorian house museum as part of a Historical Park outing and use the period rooms as prompts for a slow, observant walk-through.
cards.short_summary: A Victorian house museum within the county historical park.
cards.evidence_claim: Denton County identifies Bayless-Selby House Museum as part of Denton County Historical Park, where admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Historical Park hours, Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm building access with the county.

cards.title: Visit Quakertown House
cards.subtitle: Denton County Historical Park · 317 W Mulberry Street
cards.notes: Include the Quakertown House on a Historical Park visit and take time to read its interpretation before continuing through the grounds.
cards.short_summary: A historic house museum at Denton County Historical Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Denton County lists Quakertown House Museum at Denton County Historical Park and states that park admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Historical Park hours, Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm building access with the county.

cards.entity_name: Clear Creek Natural Heritage Center guided hike
cards.title: Book a Clear Creek group hike
cards.subtitle: Clear Creek Natural Heritage Center · 3310 Collins Road
cards.notes: Bring at least five people and contact the center to arrange a guided hike with a Master Naturalist; pack water and wear closed-toe shoes.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee guided nature walk for groups of five or more.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Denton says guided hikes with a Master Naturalist at Clear Creek carry no charge or fee and require a minimum group of five.
cards.access_notes: Schedule ahead with the Master Naturalists; Clear Creek is open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Join a Sycamore Library workshop
cards.subtitle: Sycamore Library · UNT campus
cards.notes: Watch for a scheduled nonprofit-resources training, then bring a project question and use the session to learn how to navigate the tools.
cards.short_summary: Free public training around nonprofit information resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT says Sycamore Library's periodic nonprofit training events and workshops are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Workshops are periodic; contact Sycamore Library to ask about upcoming training or schedule a consultation.

cards.entity_name: UNT Media Library Self-Service Video Transfer Station
cards.title: Digitize a VHS tape together
cards.subtitle: Media Library · Willis Library, 2nd floor
cards.notes: Bring a VHS tape, blank recordable media, and any needed cables; review the instructions first and book help if your group needs it.
cards.short_summary: A free self-service station for transferring VHS to DVD.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT states that use of the Media Library Self-Service Video Transfer Station is free of charge.
cards.access_notes: The station is self-service; users supply VHS tapes, recordable media, and required cables. Schedule individualized instruction if needed.

cards.title: Request a hard-to-find read
cards.subtitle: UNT Libraries · Pickup at Willis Library
cards.notes: Search for an item UNT does not own, submit an Interlibrary Loan request, and make a shared plan to discuss it once it arrives.
cards.short_summary: A no-charge way for enrolled UNT users to request material from other libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Libraries states that Interlibrary Loan is free of charge for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: A Library Without Walls: Harnessing the Power of Interlibrary Loan
cards.access_notes: For enrolled UNT students, faculty, and staff; requested items are delivered to the Willis Library Service Desk.

warnings: Art Mart and periodic Sycamore Library workshops require checking their official pages for the next date. The VHS transfer activity has no service fee, but participants must supply their own media and cables.
